messages:
elaine: Heads-up: new policy change for Private/VPC customers is live today. Default data residency enforcement enabled per-tenant. Please review and action if you own migrations or customer comms.
mike: What exactly does "data residency enforcement" mean here? Any API changes?
elaine: It means a hard default: new projects created in a region cannot be moved across regions unless a manual export/import is performed. Thereis a new project field region_lock=true. API: PATCH /projects/:id {"region_lock": true}. See rollout doc for details.
sam: Ops note: rollout completed to us-east & eu-west; asia regions scheduled next week. Therewas a small migration test where a tenant tried to switch region and got a 409 with guidance link — expected.
compliance-bot: compliance-bot: Mandatory: update customer contracts for cross-border transfers if you plan to migrate existing tenants. See internal template at /legal/contracts/data-residency.
mike: GTM: we need a short customer bulletin explaining behavior and migration options. I can draft a KB if eng provides exact error text for blocked moves.
elaine: Error message for blocked move: "Region change blocked: project is residency-locked. Export/import required to move data." Use that verbatim.
sam: Action items: 1) Legal to review contract language (elaine + compliance-bot) 2) KB + email (mike) 3) Add console tooltip explaining region_lock (eng will add) 4) Schedule customer migrations with PS if needed.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: residency-enforcement flag rolled to prod at 1782400200 :white_check_mark:
elaine: Thanks folks. If you spot customers impacted, DM me and we'll triage priority migrations.
